question: What carbon and nitrogen contents did XPS give for the (Pd/Cu)0.5%C3N4 photocatalyst used for photocatalytic ozonation?
rendered:
According to the document, XPS gave the following contents for the (Pd/Cu)0.5%C3N4 photocatalyst:

- C (carbon) = 43.83 at.%
- N (nitrogen) = 50.06 at.%
- O (oxygen) = 5.20 at.%
- Pd (palladium) = 0.68 at.%
- Cu (copper) = 0.23 at.%
